name: Echols-Valdosta Public Geography Demo
geographic_area: Echols County and the Valdosta-Lakeland service corridor, south Georgia
purpose: Demonstrate BloodGrid logistics on documented public geography and public facility references while retaining synthetic operations.
limitations: County boundary and listed facility locations are public-source-derived snapshots. All EMS resources, blood inventory, staffing, demand proxies, rendezvous points, incident records, operational status, trauma display attribute, and routing interpretation are synthetic demo inputs, not live operational information.
